contentText:
Apple's new Siri AI is finally here, and so far, it seems like it works . I have access and have been messing around with it, and my biggest impression so far is that Siri AI is quite curt - which I mean as a compliment.

Many AI chatbots are cheery and wordy. While a more verbose and casual personality can make a chatbot seem friendlier and more fun to talk to, there are instances of users becoming extremely attached to their chatbot of choice. People have fallen in love with chatbots . When OpenAI suddenly shut down GPT-4o, users grieved its loss , and the company brought the model back for paid users .
